The unconditional figure mixes two failures -- the test could not resolve the edge, and the edge was too small to put the focal model in front at all -- and only the first is a statement about resolution. The gap between the two is the arithmetic ceiling S4.2 previously asserted without measuring

mcspower.false_discovery_null.spec: false-discovery rate on a genuine null: 2000 i.i.d. panels at K=6, T=30 with NO planted edge, counting trials where the studentized MCS collapses to any single model, AVERAGED over 5 independent seeds (reported as a mean with its own seed-to-seed sd, since a single-seed estimate at this budget could plausibly differ by roughly this range). This is the specificity figure the paper reports, and it is measured on synthetic i.i.d. panels because neither arm of the sweep can supply one: both run on the real curated panels, which have a real best model even at a zero injected edge

cites: S4.2 body: specificity under the headline rule
mcspower.false_discovery_null_raw.spec: SAME false-discovery-rate check as mcspower.false_discovery_null, but under the RAW elimination rule -- the one the paper's own headline non-identification count actually uses -- rather than the studentized rule reported elsewhere in this section. Same 5-seed averaging as mcspower.false_discovery_null.

cites: S4.2 body: power of the studentized rule
mcspower.n_trials.spec: focal-model trials per injected-edge level: one per model per panel, swept deterministically rather than sampled. Every mcspower.* share is out of this many

mcspower.positive_control.spec: share of 2000 i.i.d. K=6 T=30 panels with a 30% additive edge on one model where the studentized MCS singles that model out. A VALIDITY GATE, not a result: the stage raises if this falls below 0.9, because a harness that cannot find an edge it planted says nothing about one it cannot find in the data

Emitted so the artifact is a published number rather than an assertion about an earlier draft

mcspower.studentized_power_0pct.spec: share of 72 focal-model trials at a 0% ADDITIVE true edge on the UNCENTERED panel where the studentized-rule MCS singles out the focal model alone. The edge is 0% of the panel's grand mean loss over all six candidates (np.mean(base)), a larger unit than the best model's own mean loss used in S3.1. This is the design the paper reports; see mcspower.recentred_power_0pct for the superseded re-centred figure (a multiplicative edge on an equal-mean panel structurally protected one high-variance model from elimination)
